---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or change to bread
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**The wall you hit**
What were you trying to build, and what stopped you? Concrete scenario, not just "it would be
nice to have X" — see this repo's
[Scope discipline](https://github.com/matteozambon89/bread/blob/main/CLAUDE.md#scope-discipline)
for why.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd want bread to do instead. Sketch the API/config shape if you have one in mind.

**Alternatives considered**
Any workarounds you're using now, or other approaches you weighed.

**Combination with existing capabilities**
bread lands a feature only when it composes with something that already exists (agents, tools,
HITL, pipelines, supervisors, loops, evals, ...) rather than standalone — which existing piece(s)
would this combine with?
